title: MCP stdio servers get a cwd (McpServer.cwd) so keel-mcp resolves the right task store
description: Evidence: mcp-connector.ts:277-283 connectStdio never passes cwd; McpServer has no cwd column (schema.prisma:1033-1060); mcp-transport.ts:230 supports options.cwd. Do: add cwd String? to McpServer (+ migration), add cwd to the stdio variant of McpServerConfigInput (contracts/src/domain.ts:657-663), plumb through mcp-connector to stdioParams, expose in McpServersOverlay.tsx (one optional field) and add_mcp_server builtin; tests. AC: db/contracts/adapters tests green; registering a stdio server with cwd=/Users/luke/dev/rakazo-setup/rakazo spawns the process with that cwd (test asserts spawn options).

context.text: McpServer.cwd added end-to-end (schema+migration, contracts stdio input+DTO, router, connector spawn options, add_mcp_server builtin, overlay field); suites green: contracts 43, db 83+6skip, adapters 1577+25skip, api 337, web 210; commit 4d400d7 pushed to lane/T-RKZ-007
